purpose: Reconcile executed MPP recurring/streamed draws against the authorized mandate envelope, prove draw-set integrity via Merkle root, and detect per-cycle cap breaches, cumulative-cap violations, and mandate-expiry/revocation breaches. Distinct from tempo-mpp-agent (pre-execution authorization): this audits the post-execution draw lifecycle.
